senses.gloss: f. (לוּן I) night-rest, staying over night, lodging.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 2:2:4">Y. Maasr. II, 49ᵈ</cite> top <he>ל׳ אינה טובלת</he> taking a night-lodging (on the road to Jerusalem) does not make Tebel (v. <cite ref="I00064"><he>טָבַל</he> II</cite>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 2:2:4">Ib.</cite> <he>מה בין ל׳ לשביתה</he> why should there be a distinction between a night-rest and a day-station?—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 2:2:4">Ib.</cite> <he>אדם מגלגל בל׳</he> one has to put up with a night’s lodging (cannot help taking it and is contented with an improvised meal) &c., v. <cite ref="C00869"><he>גִּלְגֵּל</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Chullin 91b:7">Ḥull. 91ᵇ</cite> <he>צדיק … ויפטר בלא ל׳</he> this righteous man (Jacob) has come to my lodging place (Beth El), and shall he be suffered to go without the hospitality of a night’s rest?—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 2:2:9">Y. Sot. II, 18ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>נפסלין בל׳</he> become unfit for use by being kept over night.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:33">Ex. R. s. 1</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 60:6">Gen. R. s. 60</cite> (ref. to <he>ללין</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 24:23">Gen. XXIV, 23</cite>, a. <he>ללין</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 24:25">ib. 25</cite>) <he>ל׳ אחת … לינות הרבה</he> lodging for one, … for many.—Pl. <he>לִינוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12:3">Num. R. s. 12</cite>, beg. (ref. to <he>יתלונן</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 90:1">Ps. XC, 1</cite>) <he>שלן שם ל׳ הרבה</he> where he (Moses) lodged many nights (<cite ref="Exodus 34:28">Ex. XXXIV, 28</cite>).
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 20:4">Lev. R. s. 20</cite>; a. fr.
